name: Medieval french
summary: These are knights of the fleur-de-lis. It seems an old oath still binds them to the kingdom of France ...
legend: When fog settles over the Loire, the old banners still stir in the abandoned keeps. Villagers swear they have seen the Roi de France walking the battlements at midnight, his golden crown catching moonlight, his ermine collar white as frost. Below him, a Chevalier in a blue tabard stitched with the golden lily keeps a silent watch that has outlasted the centuries. And on the eastern road, a girl in white armour, Jeanne d'Arc, still rides toward a siege no one else remembers. Templars, crossbowmen and heralds gather again beneath the fleur-de-lis, answering an oath sworn long ago in stone and steel. No one knows who called them back, or why now. But the bells of the cathedral have begun to ring on their own, and the gates of the old kingdom are slowly opening...

skins.name: Chevalier
skins.story: A silent knight in steel mail and a blue tabard with the golden lily, still guarding the keep his king left long ago.

skins.name: Roi de France
skins.story: The grey-bearded king in fleur-de-lis blue and white ermine, whose golden crown is said to glint on the battlements at midnight.

versions.note: The first banners rise again: the Chevalier takes his post and the Roi de France returns to his battlements.

skins.name: Jeanne d'Arc
skins.story: The maid in white armour and olive skirt, a white band in her hair, still riding toward a siege the world forgot.

skins.name: Templier
skins.story: Behind a sealed steel great helm and a white surcoat with a blood-red cross, the Templar keeps secrets older than the crown.

skins.name: Arbaletrier
skins.story: A bearded crossbowman in a quilted golden gambeson, his steel hat pulled low, who never misses from the castle walls.

versions.note: Jeanne d'Arc rides out once more, joined by a silent Templier and a watchful Arbaletrier on the walls.

skins.name: Du Guesclin
skins.story: Scarred and bearded beneath his mail coif, the Breton warrior wears a white surcoat with a black cross, stained red by endless battles.

skins.name: Heraut d'Armes
skins.story: The herald in deep blue and gold, studded with golden squares, who carries the king's words where swords cannot go.

skins.name: Franc-Archer
skins.story: A bearded free archer in a steel cap and blue-grey padded jack, answering the old summons from every village.

versions.note: The scarred Du Guesclin, a blue-and-gold Heraut d'Armes and a Franc-Archer answer the old summons.

skins.name: Chevalier de Bayard
skins.story: The knight without fear and beyond reproach, in polished white steel and an olive skirt, whose honour never rusted.

skins.name: Saint Louis
skins.story: A blond, blue-eyed crowned king in royal blue with a red cross on white, walking between prayer and crusade.

versions.note: The fearless Chevalier de Bayard and the crowned Saint Louis join the gathering as the cathedral bells ring on their own.
